subject: Q1 renewal: DataWave — 32-GPU reserved pool augmentation & blended rate proposal
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kahn <samir.k@datawave.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: 32-GPU reserved pool quote and term options

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear DataWave's Q1 plans. Per our discussion I've attached a draft quote that converts your current 16-GPU reserved commitment to a 32-GPU reserved pool. Highlights are below: 

- Term options: 12 months (standard) or 14 months (5% blended discount)
- Baseline: 32x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs, dedicated pool for your org
- Blended reserved rate (12-month): $5.40/hr/GPU (monthly invoiced)
- Weekday peak window guarantee: up to 95% pool availability during 8am–8pm PT
- Weekend burst: additional on-demand capacity at 60% of on-demand list price; first 2,000 burst hours/month free for first 3 months
- Throughput validation: 72‑hour capacity run during onboarding; we commit to p95 token latency target for your benchmark (details in the quote)

Attachments: redwood-quote-32gpu-20260108.pdf (line-item pricing) and an amendment template.

If you want, we can revise to a blended hourly that separates reserved hours and burst: my recommended workback is in the attached. Please loop in your procurement and let me know a target date for signature — we can align onboarding the week after DocuSign completes.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Samir Kahn <samir.k@datawave.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@datawave.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: 32-GPU reserved pool quote and term options

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. A few clarifying asks from our side: 

1) Can you clarify the blended $5.40/hr number — is that for all reserved hours or a blended across reserved + burst? We need a clean number we can put in the PO.
2) Weekend burst: would DataWave be able to guarantee the free burst hours across accounts? We run big pre-prod jobs on Sat/Sun and need predictable spikes.
3) Invoicing: procurement prefers monthly invoices addressed to DataWave AI, Inc. (W9 on file). Can you send a legal-friendly amendment rather than a Word doc?

If the term can include a short price step-down at month 7 (to help us budget), that would be interesting. Happy to sync on a 30-minute call next week.

Regards,
Samir
Head of Platform Engineering
DataWave AI
samir.k@datawave.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kahn <samir.k@datawave.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: 32-GPU reserved pool quote and term options

Samir — thanks, good questions. Answers inline below and few internal notes copied for transparency.

1) Blended rate: $5.40/hr is for reserved capacity hours only (i.e., the committed 32 GPUs). Burst hours bill at an on-demand-derived rate; in the initial offer we covered the first 2,000 burst hours/month for 3 months as a promotional credit to ease migration risk. If Procurement needs a single PO line, we can provide a blended PO line with an explicit note that burst credits expire after 3 months.

2) Free burst hours: we can reserve a burst pool that is scoped to your org and will prioritize it during weekend windows — operationally this is a soft guarantee (priority routing + capacity earmark). For a hard guarantee we need to convert some burst capacity into reserved short-term capacity; that's doable but affects pricing.

3) Legal amendment: understood. Laura — can you spin a clean amendment (redline friendly) with invoicing language and our standard customer billing block?

Dev — can we confirm onboarding window for the 72-hour capacity validation? Proposed week of Feb 2.

Internal note (Laura): If we want to keep the customer at $5.40 reserved hourly, we can structure a stepped discount at month 7 to $5.10 if they commit to 14 months. That gets them a predictable drop and keeps ARR higher.

Priyom

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Samir Kahn <samir.k@datawave.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: 32-GPU reserved pool quote and term options

Samir / Priyom — attaching a clean amendment draft and procurement-friendly billing block. Major points included: 

- 12-month standard term at $5.40/hr per reserved GPU (monthly invoiced).
- Option: 14-month term with step-down to $5.10/hr starting month 7 (applies to reserved hours only).
- Weekend burst: first 2,000 hours/month free for first 3 months; thereafter billed at 60% of on-demand rate unless customer elects to convert to temporary reserved capacity.
- Availability commitment: priority routing that targets 95% availability during the 8am–8pm PT window; credits for missed availability capped at one month of reserved fees.
- Invoicing block: invoices to DataWave AI, Inc., remit to Redwood Inference, net 30. W9 and bank details included in Doc 2.

Attachments: amendment-draft-32gpu.docx (redline friendly) and redwood-quote-32gpu-20260108.pdf

If that looks good, please confirm and we'll convert the amendment to a legal-ready PDF and send via DocuSign.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Renewals & Commercial Contracts
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

- Can you add an explicit line about data residency (us-west) in the amendment?
- Add an onboarding SLT: one week of 8–10am PT sessions for our infra team during the 72-hour run.

Procurement: procurement@datawave.ai will take the DocuSign and PO; I'll make sure the W9 matches.

Thanks,
Samir
